supporting_observations.claim: The alert description reports repeated failed domain logons involving svc-routes around 13:40 UTC on 2026-09-15, but no underlying authentication-event records or event IDs are provided.
Windows security and Sysmon collection were unavailable on both DC-COP-01 and FILE-COP-01 for the full review window, preventing direct review of authentication and host activity on those systems.

The provided context says svc-routes was scheduled for a password rotation at 13:30 UTC and re-authenticates every minute; this could explain failures after rotation, but the available evidence does not establish that explanation occurred.

known_telemetry_limitations: DC-COP-01 and FILE-COP-01 Windows security and Sysmon logs were not collected during the entire review window because of a collection outage.
Although proxy and Zeek sensors are listed as operational, no corresponding event records for the review window were supplied.
The alert is presented as a summary and has no underlying authentication-event records or event IDs in the supplied evidence.
claims_not_established: Whether the reported failed logons occurred as described, how many occurred, or their precise timestamps and status codes.
